♦ Features:
 Material: Redesigned housing and a rugged circuit board to ensure long lifespan.
 Easy to install, direct replacement, plug and play.
 Exactly OEM design to replace your defective blend actuator.
 Item Type: HVAC Heater Blend Door Actuator
 Position: Main, Air Inlet or Temperature Actuator

♦ Fitment:
 for 2012 2013 2014 Chrysler 200, Main
 for 2007 2008 2009 Chrysler Aspen, Auxiliary
 for 2007 2008 2009 2010 Chrysler Cirrus, Main
 for 2007 2008 2009 2010 Chrysler Sebring, Main
 for 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 Dodge Avenger, Main
 for 2008 2009 Dodge Durango, Auxiliary
 for 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 Dodge Journey, Main
 for 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 Dodge Caliber, Main
 for 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 Wrangler, Main
 for 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 Compass, Main
 for 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 Patriot, Main
 for 2014 2015 2016 2017 Ram ProMaster, Main
 for 2014 2015 2016 2017 Ram ProMaster 1500, Main
 for 2014 2015 2016 2017 Ram ProMaster 2500, Main
 for 2014 2015 2016 2017 Ram ProMaster 3500, Main

♦ Package Included:
 1 x 604-209 Blend Door Actuator

items.label: ♦ Fitment
items.value: Blend door actuator for a variety of Chrysler Dodge Jeep and Ram models, including for 2008-2009 Chrysler Aspen, for 2007-2010 Chrysler Cirrus, for 2007-2010 Chrysler Sebring, for 2008-2014 Dodge Avenger, for 2010-2012 Dodge Caliber, for 2008-2009 Dodge Durango, for 2009-2016 Dodge Journey, for 2014-2016 Ram Promaster 1500 2500 3500.

items.label: ♦ Replaces Part Number
items.value: 68018109AA, 604-029, 604029. Direct replacement for the blend door actuator on your vehicle.

items: Quick and simple installation for a proper fitment on driver and passenger side. Don’t forget to recalibrate you HVAC system after installation.

items.label: Function
items.value: This 604-029 replacement air door actuator controls the temperature of air from AC vents and recirculation outside air into the interior of the vehicle.

items: This 604-029 air door actuator complete with 90 days warranty, if you have any problem, feel free to contact us.
